The implementation is complete and verified. Summary of what I built in `/workspace/submission`:

**Architecture** (legacy `pipeline_allgather.py`/`topologies.py`/`to_xml.py` retained as pinned upstream code):

- **`main.py`** — strict JSON-lines I/O: one reply per input line, flushed, in-process, state preserved; malformed bytes/BOM/duplicate keys/non-finite numbers/blank lines → `{"status":"invalid"}` without ever terminating or resetting.
- **`wire.py`** — starter syntax layer (duplicate-key hook, constant rejection), unchanged semantics.
- **`controller.py`** — the full version 3.0.0 state machine: `about/load/audit/advance/edit/prepare/commit/cancel` with exact field sets, integer-only schema ranges, ASCII ID patterns, structural load relations (including first-load overlap ⇒ `invalid`, later schema-valid load ⇒ `ALREADY_LOADED`), revision/time/lease/expiry/history rules, replay cache keyed by the entire prepare payload (order-insensitive participants/envelope), and every per-operation priority (stale → REFERENCE → TIME → WINDOW, cache-before-revision, MISSING/OWNER/GONE/DENIED/replay, blocked vs force edits with actual-decrease revocation). All rates are exact integers.
- **`compiler.py`** — admission compiler: exact min-cut based deficient-cut search (one constrained cut per participant pair, early-exit, proven equivalent to brute-force subset enumeration on 400 random graphs), plus a weighted-tree/serial-route PLAN builder (residual-aware arborescence growth, pairwise max-flow availability, integral path augmentation, prefix-shared recipe circuit, representation-budget enforcement, six randomized strategy families) and a full PLAN validator mirroring the checker rules.
- **`miniflow.py`** — exact-integer Dinic max-flow with min-cut side readback.

**Validation performed**: 70+ hand-computed scenario lines (unloaded/invalid/priorities/edit-blocked/force/expiry/replay/CONFLICT/DENIED/GONE/book-window witnesses/middle participant/overflow cases), two independent certificate validators agreeing on all plans and mutations, randomized live fuzz traces with malformed noise (0 audit problems), randomized compile traces (0 problems), feasible-by-construction jobs (0 failures), and tight ring/tree/star/fabric topologies at their cut boundaries, all inside the published CPU/memory/size budgets.
